why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Konnex Points Program Go to the Konnex Points Program hub and connect your wallet.
2 Step 2 : Connect your X account Connect X first. The hub keeps the other tasks locked until it is done.
3 Step 3 : Join the community channels Join the Konnex Discord and the Konnex Telegram channel , and follow Konnex on X . Each has its own task on the hub.
4 Step 4 : Do the weekly testnet onboarding task Set up a wallet, request testKNX from the testnet faucet , then make your first transactions on the KNX testnet.
5 Step 5 : Check in weekly and refer friends Use the weekly check-in task once per week. The daily referral task rewards you with 10% of the Konnex Points your invited friends earn.
